statement: Write Del(k), for 0 <= k <= len(removable), for the byte array obtained from s by deleting the characters at positions removable[0], removable[1], ..., removable[k-1] (Del(0) = s). Here p is a subsequence of a byte array t iff there exist indices 0 <= j_0 < j_1 < ... < j_{len(p)-1} < len(t) with t[j_q] = p[q] for every q. The function returns a result r, and r is the maximum integer k such that 0 <= k <= len(removable) and p is a subsequence of Del(k).
preconditions: Valid input: len(p) >= 1, len(p) <= len(s), len(s) <= 100000, len(removable) <= len(s), every i with 0 <= i < len(removable) has 0 <= removable[i] < len(s), the values removable[i] are pairwise distinct, s and p consist only of lowercase English letters (ASCII bytes), and p is a subsequence of s before any deletion.
